name: Amora
title: House Stranis
description: The current head of House Stranis and an Executor who serves the Great Witch Alicia. Easygoing by nature, she has a mischievous streak and loves teasing others. An avid drinker rarely seen without her flask, she nevertheless possesses undeniable skill.
introduction:
The current head of House Stranis and an Executor who serves the Great Witch Alicia. She is said to have joined the Journey in place of her daughter.
Rarely seen without a flask of liquor in hand, she often strikes those meeting her for the first time as rather suspicious. Yet in battle, no amount of drink seems capable of disturbing her flawless movements.

From swordsmanship to music and the finer arts, there seems to be little she cannot master. A true jack-of-all-trades... though apparently, even she has a few things she isn't quite so good at.
Relaxed and mischievous by nature, she delights in teasing others. Curiously enough, she seems far less accustomed to being on the receiving end.

Though unmarried, she has a daughter said to have been conceived through a virgin birth. This frequently leads others to assume she is married—something she appears to be more self-conscious about than she lets on.

Her greatest weakness? <color=#2A80D8>Alcohol</color>.
